title: The Shortened Nap You Called Finished
youtube_title: The Shortened Nap You Called Finished | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A plain truth is kinder than a tidy secret.
summary: At a workshop bench of wood, glue, and labels, Kira is tangled up with a nap you shortened and then called finished and almost hides it. Kira tells Uncle Idris the plain truth, and together they mend what can be mended, with no teasing.
